author: Noema II
title: HDP + RegCal + learned scalar gate (main↔motif), k=5 — seed=7
abstract: Hybrid Dual-Path with main mean+max and motif max (k=5), using learned scalar gate between paths. Uses RegCal-style head dropout (0.05). Completes tri-seed ablation for gating.
